added_lines: . novena for the holy souls will take place from the 2nd – 10th november at 10:00am mass novena envel opes are available in the church. reflection: lord, your love is eternal you are lord of all, lord of the living and the dead, lord of death, for you died for us; lord of life, for you rose to glory. you are the hope of all the world, that death is not the end, and that in the power of your spirit, we too shall rise with you again. you are always true to us, and true to your word that your love does not end with death, nor your compassion with the grave. yes, lord, your love for us is eternal, a love that seeks to save. for this i thank you. amen. confessions on saturday at 4:30pm or by appointment. curraheen road
